# QS TopUniversities

> Global platform connecting students with top universities, scholarships, and international education opportunities through fairs, application support, and postgraduate guidance.

QS TopUniversities provides comprehensive resources for international students seeking higher education, featuring master's fairs across major cities, application counseling, and scholarship information. The platform specializes in connecting prospective students with leading institutions and supporting their journey through study abroad and postgraduate education.

## Key Topics

- Master's Fair
- QS Scholarships
- Study Abroad
- International Education
- University Networking
- Postgraduate Education
- Student Support
- University Application
- Scholarship Opportunities
- International Admissions
- Post-Graduation Work Permit
- STEM Programs
- Enrollment Counseling

## Student Support & Application Services

- [QS Student Apply Support](https://qs.topuniversities.com/qs-student-apply-support?utm_campai…=): QS Apply support for student counseling, applications, and study abroad guidance

## Master's Fairs & University Networking Events

- [Shanghai's Top Master's Fair | 11 April](https://cn.topuniversities.com/events/masters/shanghai): Master's fair in Shanghai on April 11 with top universities and scholarship opportunities
- [Beijing's Top Master's Fair | 12 April](https://cn.topuniversities.com/events/masters/beijing): Master's fair in Beijing on April 12 with top universities and scholarship opportunities
